operating_notes.text: Existing quartz kitchen sink capacity utilisation is over 81% on ~1 million units p.a.
The 1.25 million units p.a. target supersedes the 1.1 million units p.a. plan intimated on October 7, 2025.
FY25 installed capacity: quartz sinks 10,00,000 units p.a., stainless steel sinks 1,80,000, kitchen appliances 50,000 and faucets 50,000 across 6 plants.
FY20 installed capacity was 5,00,000 quartz sinks, 90,000 stainless steel sinks and 7,000 kitchen appliances across 3 plants.
Quartz sinks carry an asset turnover of ~2.5-3x, stainless steel ~3-3.5x and appliances ~4-5x.
Quartz kitchen sink capacity is being expanded from 1.0 Mn to 1.25 Mn units per annum, targeted for completion by FY27.
Carysilnox Limited expanded stainless steel kitchen sink capacity from 1,80,000 to 2,50,000 units p.a. at an investment of ₹6.7 Cr.
Carysilnox stainless steel sink capacity expanded by 70,000 units to 250,000 units per annum.
MMA raw material prices increased 25-30% during Q4FY26 but were successfully passed through to customers.
Carysil Ceramictech Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary that never commenced operations, was struck off from the Register of Companies by the RoC Mumbai.

timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026 Carysil proposed raising quartz kitchen sink capacity to 1.25 million units a year from ~1 million, a ~₹50 Cr project funded from QIP proceeds and internal accruals and targeted for completion by end-FY27.

On 25 April 2026 Carysil's investor presentation set out a planned ₹300 Cr capex for FY2027-2031 (₹120 Cr committed) to lift granite sink capacity to 1.5M units/yr and steel sinks to 500K by FY30/31, with targets of 15-20% revenue CAGR, 18-20% EBITDA margin and net debt free by 2030.
Carysil promoters declared zero share encumbrance for FY26 under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations.
Carysil submitted the monitoring agency report for Q4 FY2026 showing ₹87.86 Cr utilized out of ₹121.65 Cr net QIP proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹233.72 Cr (+14.5% YoY), net profit ₹27.38 Cr (+45.5% YoY).
Carysil reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹233.7 Cr and announced a quartz sink capacity expansion to 1.25 Mn units.
Carysil subsidiary Carysilnox Limited commenced commercial production of an additional 70,000 stainless steel sinks p.a., taking total capacity to 2,50,000 units p.a.
CARYSIL LIMITED uploaded the audio recording of its Earnings Call on May 21, 2026, via its website.
Carysil held its Q4FY26 call, reiterating 15-20% growth guidance and targeting ₹500 Cr India revenue within 5 years.
Carysil Ceramictech Limited, a non-operating wholly owned subsidiary, was struck off from the Register of Companies by the RoC Mumbai effective June 01, 2026.
